one_liner: QuickBooks Online has a broad REST accounting API with OAuth 2.0 and free developer and sandbox access. Production use needs app assessment, and reads are metered under the App Partner Program.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow. Access tokens last 60 minutes. Refresh tokens last 100 days on a rolling basis, with a 5-year hard cap. Each company (realm ID) authorizes the app individually.
access_notes: A free developer account gives a client ID, a client secret and up to 10 sandbox companies. Production use requires app assessment. Core (write) calls are free. CorePlus (read) calls are metered, with 500k free credits per month on the Builder tier.
blocker_notes: Going to production needs Intuit app assessment. Reads are metered under the App Partner Program, and calls are blocked above 500k credits per month on the free tier.

evidence.quote: Each of your clients' QuickBooks Online companies will need to individually connect and authorize your app through OAuth 2.0, since access is scoped per company
Production: For real data, requires app assessment (yes, really)
Overage: API calls are **blocked** after exceeding the 500,000 limit
Requests are throttled at 500 per minute and 10 per second per company. Intuit also provides free sandbox companies, up to 10 per developer account.
This MCP server provides complete QuickBooks Online API integration for Claude Code and other MCP-compatible clients. It includes full CRUD operations for 29 entity types and 11 financial reports
